editor.title: Edit subtitles
editor.files_hint: Double-click to open. Subtitles open in SubaDubaLingo so you can edit them.
editor.hint: Click a line to see it in the video. Drag its edges on the timeline to move it.
editor.no_video: The video is not next to the subtitle file, so there is no picture or sound.
editor.footer_fast: {n} lines are hard to read in time (over {cps} chars/s)
editor.footer_fast_one: {n} line is hard to read in time (over {cps} chars/s)
editor.keys: Enter: next line · Ctrl+Enter: split the line at the cursor · Space (outside the text): play · Ctrl+S: save · Ctrl+Z: undo · Alt+←/→: move the start 0.1 s (with Shift: the end)
editor.backup: The first version is kept in "{backup}".
editor.moved: {n} lines were moved so they do not overlap.
editor.moved_one: {n} line was moved so it does not overlap.
editor.nothing_to_save: There are no changes to save.
editor.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved. Do you want to save them?
editor.split_where: Put the cursor in the text where the line is to be split.
editor.split_short: The line is too short to split.
editor.edge_blocked: The line cannot go further: it meets the next line.
editor.words_title: Should the program remember the words next time?
editor.words_text: They go in the word list, so they are written correctly in your next videos.
editor.words_add: Add {n} words to the word list
editor.words_add_one: Add {n} word to the word list
editor.remake_check: Make the video again with the new subtitles
editor.remake_hint: The video was made with the old text. The AI assistant is not used again.
